# [EPIC] Project Setup Phase

## Epic
Stand up the initial project skeleton: directory structure for every
backend service and the frontend, a working Gradle multi-module build,
GitHub issue/PR templates and CI workflows, and a Docker Compose local
dev environment. The foundation every later service depends on.

## Business Value
Without this, there's no consistent place or build system for feature
work to land in — every later Story depends on this scaffolding
existing first.

## Product Goal alignment
Foundational: doesn't deliver a platform feature itself, but is what
makes building the self-hosted TMDB-shaped microservices platform
(docs/process/PRODUCT_GOAL.md) possible at all.

## Child Stories
- [x] #83 — a scaffolded multi-module Gradle project with CI templates and local infra
